description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small, senior engineering team as its founding backend engineer, owning the real-time infrastructure that powers AI agents on live customer video calls. You will help establish the engineering foundations for reliable, low-latency systems as usage grows.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and maintain a real-time pipeline for voice, video, and browser streaming.

 - Make infrastructure decisions across deployments, scaling, observability, incident response, and cost optimization.

 - Design and operate the Postgres and Redis data layer used by live calls.

 - Participate in on-call and respond to production incidents.

 - Ship product features, work across infrastructure, and speak directly with customers.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience building and operating production backend systems, with personal responsibility for reliability.

 - Strong backend and infrastructure fundamentals, including CI/CD, deployment, observability, and scaling on a major cloud provider.

 - Experience shipping product features in addition to infrastructure work.

 - Real-time systems experience, such as WebRTC, media servers, streaming, voice or video, low-latency systems, game servers, trading systems, or high-throughput APIs.

 - Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, Postgres, and Redis.

 - Startup experience, particularly as a founder or early engineer at a company serving real customers; audio/video or voice and avatar AI experience is a plus.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary of $200,000 to $250,000 annually, plus 1% to 2% equity. Health insurance is included. No new visa sponsorship is available. Candidates must already have U.S. work authorization; OPT, STEM OPT, H-1B transfers, and TN status are accepted.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York, with at least 4 days per week in the office.
